versions.changelog:
Version 2.4.13

- Removed detailed explanation of data flow, privacy, and notification configuration from SKILL.md to improve clarity and focus.
- Sections on system boundaries and initialization have been condensed for easier reference.
- No changes to core logic, commands, or usage — documentation-only update.
- Runtime and setup command instructions remain available and unchanged.

- Clarified network boundaries and privacy: LLM calls now explicitly described as routed only to configured providers or OpenClaw’s subagent, with clear options for disabling outbound calls.
- Removed references to deprecated shell-command notification hooks; only http(s) webhooks are now supported for notifications.
- Updated “Boundaries” section for improved accuracy and transparency about network activity and notification options.
- No code or behavior changes; documentation only.

**v2.4.11 adds explicit privacy/data flow disclosure and improves notification/webhook safety.**

- Adds a new privacy & data flow warning in the documentation, clearly stating what data is sent to LLM providers and how to disable external LLM calls.
- Removes support for shell-command notification hooks; only http(s) webhook URLs are now accepted for notifications.
- Updates skill boundaries and setup steps to reflect safer notification handling and clearer persistence/scheduling behavior.
- Removes redundant file `skill-card.md`.
- Minor clarifications throughout documentation for user consent, privacy, and safety controls.

- Added LICENSE and README.md files.
- Updated core scripts: evolver-cli.js, generator.js, unit-files.js, lifecycle.js, validator.js.
- Minor updates to SKILL.md for versioning and documentation consistency.
- Internal logic and validation improvements in scripts.
- No breaking changes to interfaces or user commands.

- Added detailed initialization flow with user-configurable modes, notification preferences, and push channel options.
- Expanded documentation for runtime commands, including advanced options for manual evolution, targeted runs, and status queries.
- Clarified boundaries: no source code modification, no real-time monitoring, and all actions are evidence-based and reversible.
- Improved user control features: pin/unpin/evict, feedback, clear/block/unblock skills with safe archiving of Evolution Units.
- Enhanced diagnostics: new commands for health checks and scheduling state audits.
